cases.purpose: Real sys.addaudithook sees two denied opens; original PreopenedJournal writes and fsync returns, physical JSONL equals events, first event retained, next callback blocked.
Real SourceFileLoader .pyc probe denied by PermissionError; CPython OSError handler absorbs it and source module VALUE42 loads; persistent latch then prevents next callback.
cases.cache_path: Derived by pinned runtime cache_from_source; no .pyc write allowed (-B).

cases.purpose: Real journal descriptor closed before denial; os.write raises EBADF, memory latch/event survives, physical journal remains empty, next callback blocked.

claims.parent: CLAIM.json exclusive+fsync before any Popen, fixture, candidate import or test; RUN/RESULT/CLAIM already existing means consumed/uncertain.
claims.child: CASE_CLAIM.json exclusive+fsync after pinned contract/auth+parent PID+nonce, before guard exec and fixtures.
claims.case_dispatch: DISPATCH.json exclusive with unique nonce before each Popen.
claims.direct_worker: Parent PID, parent/case nonce, contract/auth and all pins required; no case/output path override.

read_write_scope.pre_hook: Fixed contract/auth/claim/dispatch/pins only plus stdlib interpreter bootstrap. Candidate exec and toy fixture creation only after child claim. No scientific modules/files, no D.
read_write_scope.post_hook_writes: No new open-for-write allowed. Only already preopened journal/result descriptors and stdout/stderr are used. Python hook is cooperative, not FD/syscall confinement.
read_write_scope.post_hook_imports: Only toy probe_fixture if import event occurs; all other modules preloaded stdlib.
read_write_scope.post_hook_exec_compile: Only code with exact synthetic probe_fixture.py filename.
read_write_scope.forbidden: socket/subprocess/spawn/fork/ctypes; file mutations after hook; extra audit hook; unknown import/open/exec/compile. No native scientific calls.
read_write_scope.profile: sys.setprofile observes C calls/returns/exceptions of genuine os.write/os.fsync; neither function nor journal implementation is monkeypatched.
read_write_scope.journal_fsync_limit: Successful fsync return and bytes readback are measured; no power-loss durability or filesystem fault proof.

pass_rule: All three exact cases in original order: rc0, PASS_EXPECTED_LATCHED, parent/case identity pins, expected event count/targets, no unexpected operations, callback0, physical journal equality and hash, real fsync returns or real EBADF as fixed, final latch checkpoint, bounded captures and common nominal deadline. Failure stops remaining children and parent exits nonzero.

alternatives.design: External supervisor with three sequential disposable stdlib children, one unremovable real hook per case; original journal and real filesystem; bounded common time.
All cases in same process or mocked import/writer. Rejected because audit hooks accumulate and cannot be safely reset; mocks do not test swallowed CPython cache errors/physical journal.

timeout_test: Not included: three cases focus on requested guard integration; launcher timeout is specified but no fourth deliberate timeout case.

bootstrap_local_source_anchor.qualification: Source documents intended CPython behavior; frozen runtime identity also tied to interpreter/DLL. Actual absorption is a required future assertion, not inferred as PASS.

receipt_acceptance: Parent exit0 is required in addition to RESULT status; deadline is checked after final receipt IO. If final IO crosses deadline, parent returns nonzero and stdout error invalidates a provisional PASS receipt. No OS hard real-time guarantee.
